text:
maria: Planning to activate the activation_gate for kv-prefetch-v2 tonight. Who can own the deploy + smoke and be ready to rollback if needed?

kevin: I can take deploy ownership. Targeting 23:45 PT (06:45 UTC). Will coordinate with ops.

sana: I can run smoke + perf checks after deploy. What canary plan are we using?

maria: Canary plan: 5% for 30m -> 25% for 30m -> 100% if green. Start at 06:45 UTC. Keep the safe-default flag default=false until canary passes.

aj: FYI set of quick ops commands below. Keep these handy for rollback.

```
# set safe default to off
rbacctl set-flag kv_prefetch_v2 default=false
# flip activation gate (ops API)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \
  https://ops.redwood.internal/flags/kv_prefetch_v2/activate -d '{"enabled":true}'
```

kevin: Deploy steps (short):
- push config commit 1a2b3c -> feature toggle enabled in configstore
- restart blue worker pool (graceful)
- run smoke script from sana

kevin: Rollback plan if anything looks off: flip flag -> scale down new pool -> revert commit 1a2b3c -> monitor for 15m.

sana: Smoke script I'm going to run (quick):
```
# health check
curl -sS https://api.redwood-inference.internal/health | jq .kv_prefetch
# sample generation test
python tools/smoke.py --model gpt-test --prompt "prefetch test" --count 50
```

oliver: I'm on pager until 08:00 UTC, can cover incident response during the rollout.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by kevin at 2981234300, will post status updates to this thread.

maria: Thresholds for immediate rollback: error rate > 2% OR p95 latency > 400ms OR any clear semantic regression. If hit, set safe-default=true and notify infra.

kevin: Understood. I'll ping here when I start the push and after each canary stage.

sana: I'll post concise results: p50/p95 + error % + a quick sample from the smoke run. If green, I'll approve moving to next stage. :thumbsup:

aj: lgtm from infra side. tagging @oncall for visibility.

maria: Thanks all — timeline noted. Backup owner if kevin can't make it?

kevin: If I can't, @aj can take the push and @sana will still do smoke.

maria: Great. See you at 06:45 UTC.
